 GTA 6 could launch with 55 single-player trophies and Xbox achievements 
 GTA 6 could launch with 55 single-player trophies and Xbox achievements
 By 
 Mudassir Kamran 
 Modified Nov 08, 2026 14:27 IST 
 GTA 6 could launch with 55 single-player trophies and Xbox achievements (Image via Rockstar Games) 
 Rockstar Games could make GTA 6 a bigger challenge for trophy hunters right from launch . A new leak suggests the upcoming open-world title will feature 55 single-player trophies and Xbox achievements across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. 
 Ad 
 This would surpass the initial achievement count of GTA 5. The leak also hints at a special reward for Xbox players, potentially making completionists even more eager to explore Leonida.
 Note : The article is based on leaks and speculation.

 Rockstar Games could offer a bigger challenge for completionists with GTA 6 . According to tipster @GameRoll_ citing @TexFunz2 and @PlaystationSize on X, the upcoming title could launch with 55 single-player trophies and Xbox achievements. 
 This would surpass GTA 5, which initially offered 49 achievements on Xbox 360 and 50 trophies on PS3. The leak also suggests that Xbox players could receive a special 1,000-point Mythic achievement.
 @TexFunz2 first revealed the 55-achievement count for Xbox Series X|S. PlayStation dataminer PlayStation Game Size later confirmed the same number for PS5. However, the leaked list does not reveal individual trophy names. This could be an attempt to avoid potential story spoilers.
 Ad 
 The report also notes that Grand Theft Auto 6 could demand considerable playtime from players aiming for 100% completion. Its large Leonida map and extensive story content could make unlocking every achievement a lengthy task. The main story and additional quests reportedly require around 80 hours.
 Rockstar could also introduce more trophies through a future GTA Online successor. However, these additional achievements are unlikely to be available at launch. For now, the reported 55 objectives could make GTA 6 one of the most demanding Rockstar games for trophy hunters.
